instruction: Compute each sales representative's average sales over six months, add these averages in a new column labeled 'Average' after June, and generate a horizontal bar chart titled 'Sales Rep Performance' showing the averages.

metadata.explanation: Task requires: 1) Calculate average of each rep's sales across Jan-Jun (6 months), 2) Add 'Average' column in column H, 3) Insert averages in rows 2-11, 4) Create horizontal bar chart with title 'Sales Rep Performance'. Verified with Python: Rep averages calculated - Ivelisse Peel=482.33, Sigrid Grooms=408.33, Majorie Flaherty=375.5, etc. Evaluator checks cell H1='Average', sample cell values (H2, H3, H4), and chart properties (bar type horizontal, title correct).

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks ALL 10 sales representatives' averages (H2-H11), ensuring comprehensive verification of the calculation requirement.
Correct horizontal orientation verification: Metric properly checks chart.barDir == 'bar' to verify horizontal orientation (in openpyxl, 'bar' = horizontal, 'col' = vertical).
All expected values provided: Expected dict contains all 10 sales rep averages plus header, matching the instruction requirements.
Proper scoring logic: Proportional scoring ensures that missing or incorrect averages reduce the score appropriately (each rep contributes 6.3% of total score).
Complete instruction verification: All requirements verified - average column header, all 10 averages, chart type, horizontal orientation, and chart title.
